what_this_proves: The ten everyday sentences the audit measured as reaching nothing now reach a tool that answers, measured as a SET in one run: 49 sentences (the ten plus at least three Turkish synonyms each), uncovered ratio 65.3% before, 0% after; and on B26's 107-sentence set the unrouted count fell from 19 to 12 with the misroute count still 0.

measured_first.baseline: 49 sentences, 32 unrouted (65.3%) against the router as B26 left it, on this machine, before anything was changed. The audit's own number was 59/103 (57%).
measured_first.already_routing: 726 (clock), 727 (remember), 728 (forget) resolved before this batch - B15 and B16 closed them after the audit. Measured and put in the set; the matrix rows said MISSING.
measured_first.no_tool_at_all: 732 research cancel (REST only), 733 media volume (device capability, no caller), 735 screenshot (agent answers screen.capture, no caller) - three of the seven unrouted sentences had nothing to route TO.
measured_first.no_delete_by_policy: 731: the calendar writer has create/update and no delete (spec §1). The sentence now reaches the calendar and gets a refusal RECEIPT naming the event.

closed_fully.727_bunu_hatirla: memory_remember; four forms measured; `unutma` stays REMEMBER.
closed_fully.729_maillerime_bak: `_mail_inbox_match` now takes the mail noun with the plain look/show/check verbs and the 'var mı' question. Found on the way: 'Yeni mail var mı?' opened a DRAFT - a question never composes.
closed_fully.730_bu_hafta_ne_var: `_calendar_agenda_match` takes a day or week anchor without the calendar noun; `calendar.agenda` gained a week range (today..Sunday; 'haftaya' = next Monday..Sunday). 'Günaydın, bugün ne var?' stays the morning briefing.
closed_fully.731_toplantiyi_iptal_et: New intent CALENDAR_CANCEL (accusative appointment object + cancel verb; 'toplantı notlarını sil' is not a meeting) -> new tool calendar.cancel -> CalendarService.cancel_event: focused event resolved, refusal receipt `deletion_not_permitted`; no focus -> 'Hangi etkinlik?'.
closed_fully.732_arastirmayi_iptal_et: New intent RESEARCH_CANCEL (research NOUN + iptal/durdur/bırak/vazgeç; negation 'etme' refused) -> new tool research.cancel: active run -> mark_research_cancelled (the SAME function the REST route now calls), ledger row research.cancelled, Temporal handle.cancel() as a follow-up; nothing running -> refused receipt.
closed_fully.733_sesini_kis: New intent MEDIA_VOLUME with the direction read off the verb -> new tool media.volume -> set_volume: media_status.volume read first, one 0.25 step (mute = 0), browser.media_volume with ramp 0; nothing playing -> refused, no device call.
closed_fully.734_neler_yapabilirsin: New intent CAPABILITIES_QUERY (second-person 'yapabilirsin/olabilirsin' forms, possessive 'yeteneklerin') -> assistant.capabilities (B25). The family the owner named travels on the intent and beats the model's argument.
closed_fully.735_ekran_goruntusu_al: New intent SCREENSHOT_CAPTURE -> new tool operator.screenshot -> device screen.capture (its first caller, row 104): PNG decoded and hashed, stored under screenshots/<session>/<call>.png, receipt carries size+sha256+key and never the image; no device / undeclared capability -> capability_missing refusal; no image -> unverified failure.

found_on_the_way.yeni_mail_var_mi_composed: A question about the inbox was read as a request to compose. Closed by refusing questions in `_mail_draft_new_match`; the corpus case d.inbox.5 keeps it closed.
found_on_the_way.shield_caught_two_thefts: The first agenda widening took 'Günaydın, bugün ne var?' from the briefing and the first capabilities matcher took 'Yetenek durumu ne?' from Capability Genesis - both caught by B26's misroute set on the first run, before any new test was written.
found_on_the_way.ledger_row_dropped_silently: research.cancel's ledger row passed `research_job_id` as a string to a UUID column; the write failed inside the best-effort try and the corpus case still passed. The unit test that reads the ledger rows caught it.
found_on_the_way.half_written_b27_traces: The previous session had left a duplicate research_cancel handler in tools.py and a harness context branch that had overwritten CTX_ROUTINE_EXISTS. Both found by grep before writing, both fixed.
found_on_the_way.two_guards_on_the_first_gate: The error dictionary guard (B22) refused four new error classes with no Turkish sentence - and revealed that `ERROR_X: Final = ...` is invisible to its regex, so the two new constants are written without Final. The self-model indexer guard refused `operator.screenshot` because it was registered via a bare imported name; registered as `operator_capabilities.CAPABILITY_SCREENSHOT` like its six siblings.
